svg.title: Assembled - page 5
svg.text: A4 landscape — page 1 of 2 (sheet 5 of 9)
Section 2 of 3 - A4 landscape
Set to 297 x 210 mm, and the section after it is not. Look for the sheet changing size and orientation at the boundary rather than the
whole file taking one size, for the footer counting twice - page n of this section, sheet n of the file - and for nothing flowing across the
boundary: what does not fit adds pages to its own section, which is what makes a table changing width mid-continuation inexpressible
rather than merely discouraged.
